projection.description: Unmodified 26.2 renderer; only the main camera's projection matrix is replaced by a side-on orthographic projection with pixelsPerBlock window pixels per block that maps the camera eye to the eyeAt window pixel. The camera sits 22 blocks south of the rocket so that the vanilla perspective culling frustum (fov 70) contains the rocket, its trail and the explosion from launch to the last spark.

scene.description: One firework rocket item entity spawned by the integrated server between two server ticks (as a player's use of the item does) and mirrored by the vanilla client from the spawn packet. The integrated server and the client run in lockstep: one vanilla server tick, then the client handles every packet that tick sent, then one vanilla client tick at partialTick 0. RandomSource.create() in Entity.<init> and Particle.<init> is replaced by RandomSource.create(seeds.nextLong()) with one seeds = RandomSource.create(seed) per declared stream (server entities, client entities, client particles; ParticleSeedAgent); the random source algorithm stays vanilla. Frame tick-N is the scene after N server and N client ticks since the spawn. At 22 blocks the explosion is farther than 16 blocks from the camera, so the native starter selects the _far blast and twinkle sounds and delays them by distance; the UI port plays the near variants as declared.

scope: Projected references (ADR 0005): masked rocket item, trail and explosion pixels of one firework rocket at every tick-aligned frame (partialTick 0) at the fixed seeds; the backdrop is a declared web adaptation. Interpolated frames between ticks, other seeds and other camera arrangements are unverified. Captured on llvmpipe under Xvfb.

world.description: Fresh isolated singleplayer world from the vanilla world-creation flow: flat preset, fixed seed, spectator, peaceful, no structures. Noon with the clock paused, clear weather with the weather cycle paused, open sky around the rocket. options.txt sets no video option, so every video option is the vanilla default.
